description: Guide a student to load and inspect OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) stock data, understand what each column means, and perform basic data exploration.

student_openings.beginner_no_finance: I have some stock data files but I don't really understand what's in them. Can you help me figure out what all these numbers mean?
student_openings.intermediate_developer: I need to load and inspect some OHLCV data. What's the most efficient way to do initial data exploration with pandas?
student_openings.advanced_quant: I'm onboarding to a new dataset. I want to do a quick quality check on the OHLCV data — completeness, date gaps, corporate actions. What's your standard approach?

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Student understands what OHLCV data is, can load it with pandas, inspect shape/dtypes/head/describe, and identify the date range and any basic patterns.

required_capabilities.evidence: explains what Open, High, Low, Close, Volume mean
